# John Robert Telfer

**Role:** Uncle (Tim's brother)
**Residence:** Brisbane, Queensland (from Ungarra, South Australia)
**Education:** Cummins Area School
**Occupation:** Runs Telfer Mini Digger (earthmoving/mini digger business)

## Life Summary

John is one of Mark's uncles — brother to Tim, Grantley, Daryll, Kathryn, and Sue. Runs **Telfer Mini Digger**, an earthmoving/mini digger service in the Brisbane area.
